s.en: was already a level 20 adventurer, and has completed a true adventure. From today on, people call them a "legendary adventurer".\n\nWhole colony mood +3 (walking with a legend);

s.zh: 社交影响 +10%，囚犯、访客和商人对其好感 +10。\n\n传奇倒下时，全殖民地心情 −6（10 天）。
s.en: social impact +10%, prisoners, visitors and traders +10 opinion of them.\n\nWhen the legend falls, whole colony mood −6 (10 days).

s.zh: 攒下的经验立即结算，每升一级得 2 个传奇属性点（在“冒险者”分页投点）。
s.en: accumulated XP is settled immediately, with 2 legend attribute points per level (spent on the "Adventurer" tab).

s.en: , the colony's legendary adventurer, has fallen.

s.en: should have died, but the boon of fate kept them alive on the ground (wounds have stopped bleeding).

s.en: \n\nThousand kills: gained 1 epic boon point; another boon can be chosen.

s.zh: 听说了殖民地冒险者的名声，派出了他们的冠军
s.en: has heard of the colony's adventurers and sent its champion

s.zh: 名随从前来挑战。\n\n击杀冠军的人获得下一级所需经验的 50% 和一件魔法物品。
s.en: followers to challenge you.\n\nWhoever kills the champion gains 50% of the XP for their next level and a magic item.
(Hundred Battles Awakening detected, off by default)

s.zh: 殖民者的人形击杀达到 25、50、100、250、500、1000 时发信件，并一次性获得下一级所需经验的 30%；1000 杀额外得 1 个史诗恩赐点（可以选第二个恩赐）。\n检测到“百战觉醒”时默认关闭，避免两套里程碑重复。
s.en: Sends a letter when a colonist's humanlike kills reach 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 and 1000, and grants a one-time 30% of the XP needed for the next level; 1000 kills also give 1 epic boon point (a second boon can be chosen).\nOff by default when "Hundred Battles Awakening" is detected, to avoid two milestone systems overlapping.

s.zh: 殖民地最高冒险者等级 ≥ 12 时，每 45～60 天敌对派系派出一名冠军（等级 = 殖民地最高 + 2，最高 20，带专长和史诗恩赐）和少量随从。击杀者获得下一级所需经验的 50% 和一件魔法物品。\n检测到“百战觉醒”时默认关闭。
s.en: When the colony's highest adventurer level is ≥ 12, every 45-60 days a hostile faction sends a champion (level = colony's highest + 2, max 20, with feats and an epic boon) and a few followers. The killer gains 50% of the XP for their next level and a magic item.\nOff by default when "Hundred Battles Awakening" is detected.
